newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument gets order from TCI unit.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument gets order from TCI unit.

text.p: General Instrument Corp said Monday its NextLevel Broadband Networks Group has agreed to supply Headend in the Sky (HITS), a unit of Tele-Communications Inc with 500,000 digital cable set-top boxes.
At the National Cable Television Association trade show, GI said it will also supply HITS with equipment for cable headends sites and support services, including installation and training.
Chicago-based GI will provide its DCT-1000 digital cable set-tops, to be offered in conjunction with HITS' services to smaller cable operators, the company said.
